You shouldn’t need a root shell to understand what your TV collects.

Samsung documents opt-in viewing-history tracking through ACR. The claims of continuous microphone surveillance still need independent verification, but owners deserve clear data controls, verifiable opt-outs, and the freedom to remove unwanted telemetry from hardware they own.
